author: ProfessorUtonium
body:
We were low on CTF maps so I am here to submit some I have worked on from April-June of 2016.

These are 3 CTF maps that some mapdevs and I have made and we will be putting these hopefully in rotations soon with enough community feedback.


The Maps:

Wool Terrace

Makers: ProfessorUtonium, Hugwulf, Tazz, Arigenn, Fouled
Images: http://imgur.com/a/82Q5H
Download: no
XML: no
Description: A world made entirely on wool and some cobblestone elements. Steal the enemy flag and capture it to claim victory.
Player Size: 4v4 Minimum and 16v16 Max

Wumbo CTF

Makers: ProfessorUtonium, Hugwulf
Images: http://imgur.com/a/dNCgr
Download: no
XML: no
Description: if you don't get why it's named Wumbo, I question your childhood
The ACTUAL Description: Claim the enemy 2 flags by going through the middle and returning back to claim victory
Player Size: 4v4 Minimum and 16v16 max

Stack CTF

Makers: ProfessorUtonium
Images: http://imgur.com/a/E2a5o
Download: no
XML: no
Description: 2-3 Layers making fighting from distance different and where you must work with your team to fight and move through the enemy team land to reach the 2 flags. You can use one of the three layers to reach to the end but be careful when returning!
Player Size: 6v6 minimum to 16v16 max



more ctf maps to come soon
Please respond below what edit you would like to see in these maps and please respond if you would like to see one of these maps (or more) in the Capture rotation on the server.
so yeah
reply with any edits you would like to suggest
thanks

replies.author: OldManTigerMask
replies.body:
I really dislike the player minimum requirements. All servers should have the same requirements (2v2), with Avicus's player count 6 v 6 will be almost impossible as for no one will be able to start the game.


(The logic is, Avicus Players join when there is a match going, but before it starts no one is one basically :P)
